create_image_feature_extraction_pipeline: create an image feature extraction pipeline using a vision model like google/vit-base-patch16-224
run_image_feature_extraction: run the image feature extraction pipeline on a single image URL or local path
run_batch_feature_extraction: run the image feature extraction pipeline on a batch of images
